Prompts

```
['create a DoorEnvV0 instance to initialize a MuJoCo door manipulation environment with randomized door placement', 'step the DoorEnvV0 environment with an action array to simulate hand movement and compute reward', 'get the current observation vector including hand qpos, door position, palm and handle positions', 'reset the DoorEnvV0 environment to randomize door body position and return initial observation', 'evaluate success percentage across rollout paths by checking if door was open for more than 25 steps', 'create a HammerEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo hammer manipulation environment with actuator tuning', 'run a single simulation step in the hammer environment by providing a clipped action array', 'test the get_obs method to retrieve concatenated state vectors including hand qpos, object position, and nail impact', 'refactor the step method reward function to adjust bonus rewards for hammer lifting or nail hammering', 'review the evaluate_success method that calculates success percentage based on goal achievement across simulation paths', 'create a PenEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo pen manipulation environment with actuator sensitivity settings', 'run a simulation step on the PenEnvV0 environment by passing a clipped action array and receiving reward', 'get the observation vector from PenEnvV0 including joint positions, object pose, and desired orientation', 'reset the PenEnvV0 environment to initial state with a randomized target orientation for the pen', 'evaluate success percentage across rollout paths by checking if goal was achieved for more than 20 steps', 'create a RelocateEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo hand object relocation simulation environment', 'run a single simulation step with action array a and receive observation reward and goal info', 'test the reset_model method to randomize object and target positions and return initial observation', 'review the get_obs method that concatenates hand qpos palm object and target relative positions', 'summarize the evaluate_success method that computes success percentage from paths where goal was achieved for 25+ steps']
```
```

```

facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.create_door_env: create a DoorEnvV0 instance to initialize a MuJoCo door manipulation environment with randomized door placement
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.step_door_env: step the DoorEnvV0 environment with an action array to simulate hand movement and compute reward
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.get_observation: get the current observation vector including hand qpos, door position, palm and handle positions
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.reset_door_env: reset the DoorEnvV0 environment to randomize door body position and return initial observation
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.evaluate_success: evaluate success percentage across rollout paths by checking if door was open for more than 25 steps

facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.create_HammerEnvV0: create a HammerEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo hammer manipulation environment with actuator tuning
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.run_HammerEnvV0_step: run a single simulation step in the hammer environment by providing a clipped action array
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.test_HammerEnvV0_get_obs: test the get_obs method to retrieve concatenated state vectors including hand qpos, object position, and nail impact
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.refactor_HammerEnvV0_step_reward: refactor the step method reward function to adjust bonus rewards for hammer lifting or nail hammering
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.review_HammerEnvV0_evaluate_success: review the evaluate_success method that calculates success percentage based on goal achievement across simulation paths

facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.create_PenEnvV0: create a PenEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo pen manipulation environment with actuator sensitivity settings
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.run_step_PenEnvV0: run a simulation step on the PenEnvV0 environment by passing a clipped action array and receiving reward
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.get_obs_PenEnvV0: get the observation vector from PenEnvV0 including joint positions, object pose, and desired orientation
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.reset_model_PenEnvV0: reset the PenEnvV0 environment to initial state with a randomized target orientation for the pen
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.evaluate_success_PenEnvV0: evaluate success percentage across rollout paths by checking if goal was achieved for more than 20 steps

facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.create_RelocateEnvV0: create a RelocateEnvV0 instance to initialize the MuJoCo hand object relocation simulation environment
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.run_step: run a single simulation step with action array a and receive observation reward and goal info
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.test_reset_model: test the reset_model method to randomize object and target positions and return initial observation
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.review_get_obs: review the get_obs method that concatenates hand qpos palm object and target relative positions
facebookresearch_eai-vc/third_party/mj_e.summarize_evaluate_success: summarize the evaluate_success method that computes success percentage from paths where goal was achieved for 25+ steps
